_eligibility_text: 1. The scheme is available to all Indian citizens who are aged below 18, including Non-Resident Indians (NRIs) and Overseas Citizens of India (OCIs) 1. The account should be opened by parents/guardian in the minor's name, as they will operate the account exclusively for the benefit of the minor. 1. If the guardian is court-appointed, they must submit a copy of the court order confirming the guardianship and KYC documents. 1. The guardian must comply with KYC norms as per the Pension Fund Regulatory and Development Authority (PFRDA) requirements.
